name: LingoQA
intro: LingoQA是一个针对自动驾驶领域视觉问答的新型数据集和基准。该数据集包含2.8万个独特的短视频场景和41.9万个标注。对最先进的视觉语言模型进行评估表明，它们的性能仍低于人类水平。LingoQA引入了一个名为Lingo-Judge的真实性分类器，其与人类评估的Spearman相关系数达到0.95，超越了现有技术。该基准旨在作为自动驾驶视觉语言模型的评估平台。
intro_en: LingoQA is a novel dataset and benchmark for visual question answering in the autonomous driving domain. It contains 28,000 unique short video scenes and 419,000 annotations. Evaluations of state-of-the-art vision-language models show their performance still lags behind human level. LingoQA introduces Lingo-Judge, a fidelity classifier with a Spearman correlation of 0.95 against human evaluations, surpassing existing methods. This benchmark aims to serve as an evaluation platform for autonomous driving vision-language models.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2312.14115. LingoQA builds autonomous-driving VQA data from 4-second 1Hz driving clips. The Action dataset starts from recorded driving sessions with notable vehicle behavior changes, operator descriptions, perception metadata, prompt templates, and GPT-3.5 rephrasing/extension, producing 24,577 snippets and 167,774 QA pairs. The Scenery dataset densely annotates three 30-minute sessions in ELAN across about 15 caption categories and uses GPT-4 chain-of-thought prompting to generate perception QA. The evaluation set is created by in-house human labelers, double labeling and resolving disagreements into 1,000 high-quality answers for 500 questions, and Lingo-Judge is trained from human-correctness labels to score model answers with high human correlation.
